name: language-agent
description: language-agent workspace root — pnpm workspace scaffold, boundary gates, and root CI scripts. All product code lives under src/ (src/packages/*, src/apps/*, src/sidecars/*); package content is owned by the individual packages/apps (see docs/decisions/language-module-architecture.md §5.2 for the exclusive-ownership map).

scripts.boundary:lang-conditional: eslint --config eslint.config.mjs src/packages/engine src/apps/server/src src/apps/web/src/shell && bash scripts/check-no-lang-conditional.sh
scripts.spec:generate:node: pnpm --filter @la/contract run generate:sidecar-client && pnpm --filter @la/lang-ar run generate:annotation-schema
scripts.spec:generate: pnpm run spec:generate:node && pnpm run spec:generate:python
